description: This file defines the 'Replace' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides static methods for string manipulation such as replace and substitute, handling both scalar and array inputs, and integrating with helper functions and error handling specific to spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Replace
classes.description: Provides string replacement and substitution methods used in spreadsheet calculations, supporting array inputs and integration with other calculation helpers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a portion of a string or array of strings starting at a specific position for a certain length with new text.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring within a string or array of strings, supporting specifying which occurrence to replace or replacing all.

methods.name: executeSubstitution
methods.description: Executes the substitution operation for a specific occurrence, handling position calculation and calling the scalar replace function.
